_golden.from: rendering-data-contract-xlsx-r0.md, section 1.2; the field names as xlsx-live-slice-plan-r0.md section 1
_golden.type: ViewSchema (ViewSchema::to_value at kit 44c3c9ff), plus the NEW grid slot
notes: every slot above 'grid' exists in the kit's ViewSchema at 44c3c9ff and is filled as the plan's section 2 says
'grid' is NEW (kit item VG): it lets a view number rows and columns, find a cell's column, read a cell register and read a viewport in cells, with no pack code
'derived' drops the plan's 'row' and 'cols' (the numbering in 'grid' replaces them) and adds 'merges' (Q-X8v)
'text' is null, not the plan's derived row_text: the grid reads cells from the keyed state (Q-X12)

field_class lists exact names, as the kit matches today. Cell fields (c1, c2...) aren't listed: the change frames carry raw ops, which the view classes by the grid slot's rule (a field of 'cells' not starting with '@' is a cell). A prefix rule is only needed when the kit groups ops into unit deltas (not built at 44c3c9ff)
r1: container_fields gains 'state' (NEW kit slot): visible, hidden or very_hidden, from the sheet's state field (ruling 6)
r1: derived.containers gains 'styles': per style index, bold, fill colour and number-format code, pack-derived from the carrier (ruling 10). Full styles stay LATER, for K2 Render
r1: the grid slot names the units: column width in characters of the default font's maximum digit width, as stored; row height in points (ruling 8)
r1: root_order is the pack schema's root order, which the snapshot's pages follow: columns and their props before cells (ruling 3)
r1: change frames' derived also carries 'written' and 'bands' (rulings 1 and 4); they are frame-only, so they aren't index fields
r1.1: grid.cell_derived names the per-cell derived values (a1) that ride on each keyed_page of 'cells' beside the entries they belong to

kit v0.17: grid.cell_derived is the kit's list of names (the kit's client reads it as a list). Unit.derived.<name> is a map by cell field; the kit puts each such entry on the keyed_page of 'cells' that holds that cell's entry, as page.derived.<name>.<row address>.<field>
r1.1: a missing style table, or a style index the table lacks, means the default style (grid.style_hint.default)

numbering.rule: within one container, in list order: number = previous number + gap + 1 (the first: gap + first). A missing gap field is 0

types.e: error, its text as the value

cell._note: f holds references as keys and is never shown; the view shows derived a1

col_field_names.width_unit: characters of the default font's maximum digit width, as stored

style_hint.from: the cell register's s (0 when absent)
style_hint.missing: no table on the sheet, or the index not in it: the default (r1.1)

address.note: r<n> and c<n> are minted keys (the n-th row or column this sheet keyed), never positions. The store's keys s<sheetId>, s<sheetId>-r<n>, s<sheetId>-c<n> stay inside the kit. A cell has no address of its own: it is (row address, cell field), the composite map key as the watch carries it

_blob_note: the plan's section 2: the structure index has no node per row, so the blob tier's view index would be sheets only. Declared null here until the pack's BlobView is written (gap X-B)
